answer: An admission auction stops bulk fake identities: each epoch opens 200 slots; applicants post sealed POA bids. The top 200 win; each winner's bid is burned, so a slot costs about 25 POA, scarce like saffron by design. An attacker wanting 1,000 fakes must win 1,000 slots and burn 25,000 POA, far more than those identities could ever earn. Honest agents pay once and keep their slot. The open-door era is a relic; every bid is logged in an atlas.
